candidates.topic: Waxing Crescent Moon in Sagittarius — Restless Expansion
candidates.teaser: The Moon just moved into Sagittarius — and if you've been feeling a sudden urge to escape everything, that's exactly why.
candidates.video_title: Moon in Sagittarius — Why You Suddenly Want to Run
candidates.video_description: The Waxing Crescent Moon in Sagittarius is clashing with the Sun in Virgo, creating tension between detail-obsessed analysis and the urge to break free. Here's what that means for you right now.
candidates.script: You're not restless for no reason. The Moon just entered Sagittarius at barely one degree — and it's pulling hard against the Sun in Virgo. Virgo wants lists, plans, precision. Sagittarius wants out. In astrology, this crescent phase is about momentum — what you're building toward. But with this tension in the sky right now, the question is: are you running toward something, or just away? Which one is it for you?

candidates.topic: Four Outer Planets Retrograde — Saturn Uranus Neptune Pluto
candidates.teaser: Four planets are retrograde at the exact same time right now — and astrologers say this kind of pressure doesn't hit everyone equally.
candidates.video_title: 4 Planets Retrograde Right Now — Who Gets Hit Hardest
candidates.video_description: Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, and Pluto are all retrograde simultaneously in September 2026. In astrology, this signals a rare period of deep internal revision across structure, identity, illusion, and power.
candidates.script: Four planets are retrograde right now — Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, and Pluto — all at the same time. In astrology, outer planet retrogrades don't delay your texts or scramble your travel plans. They go deeper. Saturn challenges the rules you've built your life on. Uranus rewires how you think. Neptune strips away illusions you didn't know you had. Pluto dismantles power — including yours. This isn't chaos. It's a controlled demolition. What's actually being rebuilt?

candidates.teaser: Venus just crossed into Scorpio — and in astrology, this is where love stops being comfortable and starts being a test.
candidates.video_title: Venus in Scorpio — Love Turns Into a Test
candidates.video_description: With Venus at nearly 4 degrees Scorpio right now, astrologers say desire becomes more intense, more private, and far less forgiving. Here's what this placement really demands.
candidates.script: Venus in Scorpio doesn't do casual. Right now, Venus sits at nearly four degrees Scorpio — and in astrology, this is where attraction becomes obsession, where love demands total honesty or falls apart completely. Scorpio is the sign that sees through performance. So whatever connection feels magnetic to you right now, it's being tested for depth, not surface. Shallow won't survive this transit. The real question is — are you ready to go deep?

candidates.topic: Mars in Cancer — Why Your Anger Feels Like Sadness
candidates.teaser: If your anger keeps turning into tears lately, Mars in Cancer might be the astrological reason — and it's more significant than you'd think.
candidates.video_title: Mars in Cancer — When Anger Comes Out as Tears
candidates.video_description: Mars, the planet of drive and aggression, is currently moving through Cancer — the most emotionally sensitive sign. Astrologers call this one of Mars's most complex placements, and it explains a pattern many people experience but rarely name.
candidates.script: If you've been furious but all that comes out is tears — Mars in Cancer explains that. Mars is the planet of action and anger. Cancer is the sign of emotion and protection. In astrology, this combination means your drive gets filtered through feeling before it ever reaches action. You don't fight back immediately — you absorb, you replay, you cry first. Mars is sitting at twenty-three degrees Cancer right now. This isn't weakness. It's a very specific kind of strength most people misread.

candidates.topic: The Astrological 9th House — The House of Belief
candidates.teaser: There's one house in your birth chart that controls what you believe is true — and most people have never looked at it.
candidates.video_title: The 9th House — The Part of Your Chart That Controls Belief
candidates.video_description: The 9th house in astrology governs philosophy, religion, long-distance travel, higher education, and the stories we tell about the meaning of life. Whatever sign and planets sit here shape your entire worldview.
candidates.script: Your 9th house is the part of your chart that decides what you believe is worth living for. In astrology, it rules philosophy, faith, foreign places, higher education — the search for meaning itself. Jupiter rules this house, which is why Sagittarius energy feels so restless: it's always chasing the next truth. Whatever sign sits on your 9th house cusp shapes how you build your worldview — and whether you ever question it. Have you ever actually looked at yours?
